content:
The long-awaited "Ted Lasso" is about to make its return, with the fourth season premiering on Apple TV+ next week (watch here). Apple has also just released the official trailer.

The "Ted Lasso" Season 4 trailer focuses on beloved returning characters and a brand-new cast

Apple TV+'s most anticipated premiere of the year is coming next week: "Ted Lasso" Season 4, scheduled to debut on August 5.

This widely beloved comedy starring Jason Sudeikis has been off the air for over three years since its previous season. The new season shifts the focus from the AFC Richmond men's team to a newly formed "Lady Greyhounds" team.

Click here for a full introduction to all the new cast members joining the show, as well as a list of actors who will not be returning.

The new trailer released today reveals little about the plot, instead using the soundtrack of Mumford & Sons and clips of beloved characters to create a strong sense of Lasso nostalgia.

Below is the official Season 4 synopsis, along with the new trailer:

If you love "Ted Lasso," another heartwarming comedy worth watching is "Trying," currently streaming on Apple TV+. The show's fifth season is now airing, and it has a 97% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

What are your thoughts on the new "Ted Lasso" trailer? Feel free to leave us a comment.

Apple TV+ subscription plans start at $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe via the Apple One bundle for added savings.
